categories.label: Book Covers
categories.blurb: Cover art that makes a small reader pick the book up — warm characters, one clear feeling, and room for the title to breathe.

categories.label: General Illustration
categories.blurb: Story moments, editorial pieces and dreamy scenes — the everyday whimsy of clouds with opinions and trees that gossip.

categories.label: Character Design
categories.blurb: Turnarounds, expressions and tiny personalities. Every character gets a favourite snack and a secret fear.

categories.label: Surface Pattern
categories.blurb: Seamless repeat patterns for fabric, wallpaper, stationery and packaging — built to tile beautifully at any size.

works.title: The Moon's Lost Slipper
works.blurb: A bedtime cover about a moon who misplaces one shoe and borrows the tide to find it.
works.alt: Pastel lavender book cover illustration of a glowing moon over soft rolling hills with sparkles.
works.detail: The brief called for ‘cosy, but with a tiny bit of adventure’. I kept the palette to moonlight lilac and cream so the title type can sit in the open sky, and gave the hills a gentle wobble so nothing feels ruled by a straight edge.

works.title: Pip and the Paper Whale
works.blurb: A small girl folds a whale from a bus ticket and sails it across the kitchen floor.
works.alt: Pastel peach and cream book cover illustration of a small child riding a paper whale.
works.detail: A cover that had to read at thumbnail size. One big shape (the whale), one warm face (Pip), and a lot of soft air around both. The peach wash was painted wet-on-wet so the paper grain stays visible in print.

works.title: The Very Shy Thundercloud
works.blurb: A thundercloud who is too polite to rain, until a wilting sunflower asks nicely.
works.alt: Pastel butter yellow book cover of a fluffy cloud character above flowers.
works.detail: Character-first cover. The cloud needed eyebrows expressive enough to carry the whole joke, so I built a turnaround of forty expression sketches before painting the final.

works.title: Map of Small Brave Things
works.blurb: A middle-grade cover about a folded map that only shows places you are afraid of.
works.alt: Pastel lavender middle grade cover with a moon, hills and wandering path.
works.detail: Middle-grade covers carry more mystery, so I let the path lead off the edge of the page. The spot gloss on the map fold was flagged in the layered file for the printer.

works.title: Noodle the Library Cat
works.blurb: A cat who shelves books by how they smell, and a librarian who lets him.
works.alt: Pastel mint book cover illustration of a round cat among books and plants.
works.detail: Warm, funny and domestic. I built the shelf pattern first, then hid three easter eggs in the spines for the author's own cats.

works.title: When the Garden Woke Up
works.blurb: A springtime cover about a garden stretching after a long winter nap.
works.alt: Pastel sky blue book cover of flowers and hills waking in spring.
works.detail: Designed as a series look: same horizon height, same hill rhythm, rotating palette per season so the four books sit nicely as a set.

works.title: Clouds With Opinions
works.blurb: An editorial piece about weather that argues back.
works.alt: Pastel blue illustration of layered hills, flowers and soft clouds.
works.detail: Commissioned for a children's magazine spread on climate feelings. I gave each cloud a different silhouette so young readers can tell them apart at a glance.

works.title: The Long Way Home
works.blurb: A quiet scene of a walk that takes all afternoon on purpose.
works.alt: Pastel illustration of a winding landscape with soft hills and floating sparkles.
works.detail: Painted as a full-bleed spread. The composition uses three overlapping hill bands to build depth without a hard horizon line, which keeps the mood floaty.

works.title: Tea for the Tin Robot
works.blurb: A robot learns that a small cup is a big kindness.
works.alt: Pastel scene with a friendly round character among flowers and hills.
works.detail: Part of a series on kindness for a school reader. Simple shapes, one strong light source, and a lot of emphasis on the hands.

works.title: Starlight Delivery
works.blurb: Someone has to carry the stars down before morning.
works.alt: Pastel night illustration with a large moon and sparkles over hills.
works.detail: Night palettes for children are a balancing act — dark enough to feel like bedtime, never so dark the picture turns heavy. I kept the shadows tinted violet rather than grey.

works.title: The Picnic That Grew Legs
works.blurb: A blanket, a basket, and one very determined ant.
works.alt: Pastel daytime illustration with flowers, a blanket of colour and rolling hills.
works.detail: A crowd scene kept readable by grouping characters into three clumps with clear gaps, and reserving the brightest colour for the runaway basket.

works.title: Rainy Day Window
works.blurb: Looking out at weather is its own kind of cosy.
works.alt: Pastel illustration of a soft rainy landscape seen through a round window shape.
works.detail: Painted with the raindrops masked out first, so each one keeps a sharp wet edge against the soft blurred background.

works.title: Momo the Marshmallow Bear
works.blurb: Round, brave, and slightly sticky.
works.alt: Pastel peach character illustration of a soft round bear-like creature.
works.detail: Delivered as a full sheet: front, three-quarter and side view, scale reference next to a household object, and a twelve-expression chart. Momo's silhouette is a single soft circle so he animates and merchandises easily.

works.title: Wren, Keeper of Keys
works.blurb: A quiet kid with too many pockets and a lantern that never goes out.
works.alt: Pastel character illustration of a small cloaked figure with a glowing lantern.
works.detail: Costume built from a mood board of thrifted coats. Every pocket holds a real prop listed in the bible, which later gave the writer six story hooks for free.

works.title: Bramble the Garden Gnome
works.blurb: Grumpy about slugs, secretly the softest in the garden.
works.alt: Pastel character illustration of a small round gnome figure among flowers.
works.detail: Built a prop sheet of his tools first — the character arrived once the trowel looked well used.

works.title: Paper Dragon, Small Version
works.blurb: Origami dragon who is certain she is terrifying.
works.alt: Pastel character illustration of a folded paper dragon creature.
works.detail: The challenge was keeping the geometry believable while still letting the face perform. I kept fold lines as flat pastel planes and animated only the eyes and jaw.

works.title: The Tidy Monster
works.blurb: Arranges the forest floor into neat little piles, which the squirrels find deeply annoying.
works.alt: Pastel character illustration of a fluffy friendly monster shape.
works.detail: A rare villain who is not a villain — just particular. The colour story uses warm peach for him and cool greens for the disrupted forest, so the conflict reads without dialogue.

works.title: Sun and Moon, Siblings
works.blurb: Two celestial siblings who keep swapping shifts.
works.alt: Pastel character illustration of two glowing celestial figures side by side.
works.detail: Designed as mirror silhouettes so they read as a matched pair on a shelf or a spread, with reversed palettes to tell them apart instantly.

works.title: Meadow Repeat
works.blurb: Daisies, dots and little sparks — a spring repeat for fabric and stationery.
works.alt: Seamless pastel mint surface pattern of flowers, dots and sparkles.
works.detail: Built at 60 cm repeat, delivered as layered TIFF and flattened JPEG. Tested for visible seams in half-drop, straight and brick layouts.

works.title: Confetti Picnic
works.blurb: A playful toss pattern with tiny treats scattered at every angle.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of scattered shapes and dots on a soft background.
works.detail: A tossed layout with three scales of motif, which lets the same artwork work as pyjama print and as a gift-wrap border.

works.title: Moon Garden
works.blurb: Night-blooming flowers in muted lilac for grown-up nurseries.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of soft flowers and shapes on a muted background.
works.detail: A more grown-up palette for the nursery market: the same whimsy, dialled to dusk so it works on walls for years rather than months.

works.title: Tiny Weather
works.blurb: Raining a little, shining a little, all at once.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of weather motifs and dots.
works.detail: Designed to be chopped into strips for notebook covers, washi tape and page borders without losing the rhythm.

works.title: Berry Season
works.blurb: A kitchen-textile repeat with fruit, leaves and sprinkles.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of berry and leaf shapes on a cream background.
works.detail: Colour-separated for screen printing with four spot colours, and simplified linework so it survives on woven linen.

works.title: Cloud Atlas
works.blurb: Soft sky shapes that drift just enough to feel alive.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of cloud shapes and sparkles.
works.detail: A large-scale repeat designed for feature walls, with a small companion coordinate for the surrounding three walls.

works.title: Bunny Band
works.blurb: A marching line of small friends, endlessly.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of small round characters in a row.
works.detail: A border print and a tossed print cut from the same motif library, so a clothing range stays visually consistent across styles.

works.title: Sugar Sprinkle
works.blurb: Pure celebration, no occasion required.
works.alt: Seamless pastel pattern of colourful sprinkles and confetti shapes.
works.detail: Delivered in six recolours for a party-goods range, all from one layered master file so the client can order new palettes cheaply.
